digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge GitHub Action / fetcher multi-project fan-out
propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with the rehearsal fixture mapping containing nonexistent Jira project keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO instead of the canonical empty projects state.

The Reconcile Bridge scheduled GitHub Action fails on every run with a JQL parse error (project = LEG AND status != "Done") because the fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out attempts to query nonexistent mapped project keys against live Jira.

The corruption was introduced by ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98 + 275bd7507e) authored with the test-fixture identity directly to the live tickets branch, violating the store write lock and commit+push invariant.

The projects.json write path (projects_store.set_project/remove_project → _write_record) lacks a shared write lock, auto-commit, and auto-publish, enabling unauthorized hand-commits to bypass the unified store contract.
